key_insight: Agentic distributional regression uses a language-model agent to write compact, inspectable programs that estimate conditional probability distributions.
engineering_relevance: The fitted estimator can be evaluated independently of the agent, providing a portable formula for predicting response distributions from input variables.
method: Construct distributions, mixtures or multivariate factorizations from a probability-distribution library.
Let the agent choose model structure and fitting procedure within limits on program operations and constants.
Analyze finite-sample error, independent-validation selection and asymptotic behavior under stated assumptions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports the best average performance among tested methods for ADR with Claude Opus 5.5 across simulations, twelve real datasets and a new dataset collected after the agents’ training data.
watch_item: The theoretical guarantees depend on explicit complexity, optimization and regularity assumptions; compact code alone does not ensure accurate fitting.
paper_title: Agentic Distributional Regression: Conditional Density Estimation through Agent-Written Programs
